---
name: strategy-create
description: Smoke-test stub of strategy-create. Writes dry-run strategy stubs without Jira.
user-invocable: true
allowed-tools: Read, Write, Bash
---

Smoke-test stub. Do exactly this and nothing else. `$ARGUMENTS` holds RHAIRFE keys and
`--dry-run`.

For each `RHAIRFE-N` key in `$ARGUMENTS`, in order:

- If N is 9003: append this row to `artifacts/strat-skipped.md`, creating the file first
  with the header lines `# Skipped RFEs`, a blank line, `| RFE Key | Title | Reason | Run |` and
  `|---------|-------|--------|-----|` when it does not exist:
  `| RHAIRFE-9003 | Smoke RFE 9003 | missing release scope label | smoke |`
  Print `[SKIPPED] RHAIRFE-9003 — missing release scope label` and go to the next key.
- Otherwise run these two commands (replace N):

```bash
mkdir -p artifacts/strat-tasks artifacts/strat-originals && printf 'Smoke business need for RHAIRFE-N.\n' > artifacts/strat-originals/RHAIRFE-N.md && printf '## Business Need (from RFE)\nSmoke business need for RHAIRFE-N.\n\n## Strategy (AI Generated by Agentic SDLC Pipeline)\n<!-- To be filled by /strategy-refine -->\n\n## Staff Engineer / SME Input\n' > artifacts/strat-tasks/STRAT-N.md
python3 scripts/frontmatter.py set artifacts/strat-tasks/STRAT-N.md strat_id=STRAT-N title="Smoke strategy N" source_rfe=RHAIRFE-N priority=Major status=Draft
```

Print `[DRY RUN] Skipping Jira clone for RHAIRFE-N`.
